title: Someone made a single-player version of World of Warcraft powered by AI

posts.cooked: A WoW developer created a private server populated by 1,800 AI bots. These bots leveling, questing, runs dungeons, and even chatting with the player. It is a proof-of-concept for a single-player MMO where AI agents simulate a living, breathing community, providing a symmetric value where players can raid solo with intelligent AI companions.
